question: What qualification must a previously accomplished recipient meet before a certain gift is to be given to him?
premises: A gift is prescribed as something to be given.
The intended recipient is one who has been previously accomplished.
That recipient must have been tested for the course of one year.
inference: The gift is to be given only to a previously accomplished person who has passed a one-year test.
uncertainties: The nature of the gift itself is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: What is to be given should go to one who was previously accomplished and has been tested for one year.
